concerns.text: The plan specifies contracts (dataset.schema.yaml, model_output.schema.yaml, literature_expectations.yaml) that must be created, but no task in tasks.md is assigned to generate these contract files. This leaves FR‑001/FR‑002 and the constitution’s data‑hygiene and single‑source‑of‑truth principles unaddressed.

The deliverable data‑model documentation (data-model.md) and quickstart guide (quickstart.md) are listed in the plan, yet there is no corresponding task to produce them. Absence of these artifacts breaks traceability for the data entities defined in the specification.
